problem: F91 learned no beneficial labels from 768 train-only terminal-action counterfactuals; its safety gate remained inactive. Need a denser scientifically bounded temporal reward that may identify useful public relationship retention before full terminal success is attained.
hypothesis: Training on changes in task-chain role-prefix reachability after a fixed native F60 suffix, using TRAIN-only question and future event information, can produce a discriminating query-blind action advantage model with less sparse positive credit while protecting F60 on unseen four-step questions.

algorithm.teacher: For each training-only public case at prefix indices 11,23,35,47,59,71, take exact native F60 baseline afterstate and up to 8 F62-legal nonbaseline afterstates in source enumeration order. Complete the same future public suffix under unchanged F60 for both. Compute maximum legal role-step prefix reachability under frozen PACK codec from the TRAIN question start and ordered operators; exact complete F85 terminal accuracy additionally scores +2 for right answer. Reward = reachable_prefix_steps / question_steps + 2 * indicator(frozen F85 returns true TRAIN answer). Advantage = alternative_reward - baseline_reward; label beneficial when >0, harmful when <0, else neutral. Distinguish these surrogate-reward labels from independently correct terminal outcomes.
algorithm.online: Independent of future events, TRAIN question/answer, source regime or seed. Use source-native F62.actions, frozen F60 fallback, 12 public-only feature values: 1 intercept plus 11 F62._features(after)-features(F60 baseline) differences. Frozen dual logistic heads for beneficial and harmful labels, 4 epochs, step .08, shrink .995, benefit class 4x, harm class 6x, signed int8 clamp [-96,96]. Pick exact source-native alternate only if predicted benefit >=0.68, harm <=0.18, score margin >=0.50, index>=24, at most one intervention/72 events, and candidate retains >=min(10,len(baseline)-1) native F60 records. F85 reasoning unchanged.
algorithm.persistent_budget: 144 bytes (12 native 12-byte records), plus separately counted 24 parameter bytes and 1-bit used latch. No hidden state/future or additional controller.
algorithm.training: 32 cases x family -2/-1, 6 fixed prefixes, up to 8 legal alternatives each. No random fitting, threshold search, guard lookups, or selected checkpoints after experiment.
algorithm.same_frozen_controls: F60 native, F83 learned, F90 temporal, F91 conservative, all on exact same F85 query-time global solver. Exact Git blob and public-prefix auditor attestation.

cohorts.source: F76 frozen negative synthetic two-arrival-regime source only; protected original/FIT/DIAG/F3 inaccessible

evidence_steps: P0 prereg code and cohorts before training
P1 unit/regression qualification and TRAIN only. Emit deterministic 24-int8 weights plus label counts without touching validation/guard.
P2 separately commit immutable trained weights, hash and training job identity before validation/guard.
P3 one GitHub-hosted VALIDATION and one GUARD evaluation on disjoint new synthetic seeds. Never refit or change decision code after seeing them.
P4 publish verbatim result, scientifically accept only if zero F60-correct regressions and >=1 F60-failed six-step rescue on guard, otherwise negative.
